checks.detail: The bundle builder is a single deterministic walk with name-based exclusion markers and a byte-size threshold; entries and exclusions are sorted, hashes are computed per file, and no mutation API exists on the audit path.
Excluded content is never read into the manifest (only name/size/reason are recorded), so secret and holdout bytes cannot leak into the output; tests assert absence of both marker content and values.
All tests create temp directories and never touch real data, authority, operational, policies, inventories, research, or KBase content; real-store read-only CLI paths opt in explicitly and only read.
